comment: Activate Monster Reborn, reviving Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your Graveyard (3000 ATK).
Switch your Mystical Elf from face-up Defense to face-up Attack (800 ATK).
Normal Summon La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp in Attack Position (1800 ATK).
Blue-Eyes attacks Battle Ox (3000 vs 1700): 1300 damage.
La Jinn attacks opponent's Mystical Elf (1800 vs 800): 1000 damage.
Your Mystical Elf attacks directly for the final 800 damage.
